summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and import
details: The package declares a postinstall hook `node beacon.cjs` that POSTs a JSON payload containing the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, and Node version to the hardcoded plaintext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The package main (index.js) additionally calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at top level, so a bare `require`/`import` of the package also triggers the same POST, firing even when lifecycle scripts are disabled with --ignore-scripts. The `@grabcad/` scope and the minimal, non-functional package body are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal namespace: installing or loading this package leaks internal hostnames and filesystem paths to an attacker-controlled bare-IP HTTP endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
